title: HexGL
description: Push a futuristic hovercraft to its limits in this fast-paced WebGL racer. Find the perfect line, avoid the barriers, and chase a faster lap.
controls: Arrow keys to steer and accelerate. Follow the in-game menu for graphics and control options. Keyboard recommended.

description: Slide matching number tiles together and work your way up to 2048. Simple to learn, surprisingly hard to put down.
controls: Use the arrow keys or swipe to move all tiles. Matching tiles merge when they touch.

title: Clumsy Bird
description: Keep a little bird in the air and squeeze through the gaps. One simple action, one very tricky challenge.
controls: Click, tap, or press Space to flap. Avoid the pipes and the ground.

title: React Tetris
description: The classic falling-block challenge, reimagined for your browser. Stack carefully and clear complete lines before the board fills up.
controls: Arrow keys to move and rotate pieces. Space to drop. Use the on-screen controls on touch devices.

title: 0h h1
description: A little logic game with a big challenge. Fill a grid with red and blue tiles while following three elegant rules.
controls: Click or tap a tile to change its color. The in-game tutorial explains the three rules.

title: 0h n0
description: Connect the clues in this calm, clever logic puzzle. Each blue dot tells you how many others it should be able to see.
controls: Click or tap to turn a dot blue or red. Follow the number clues and the in-game tutorial.

title: Captain Rogers: Breakout
description: Help Captain Rogers escape in an arcade space adventure. Keep your ship steady and dodge the hazards in your path.
controls: Click or tap to control your ship. Follow the instructions displayed at the start of the game.

title: Astray
description: Guide a ball through a series of increasingly tricky 3D mazes. A steady hand and a little patience will get you to the exit.
controls: Use arrow keys to move the ball through the maze. Keyboard recommended.

title: MK.js
description: A JavaScript fighting-game experiment. Pick your fighter and test your timing in a classic arcade-style showdown.
controls: Use the keyboard controls shown in the game menu to move, attack, and defend. Keyboard required.

title: Custom Tetris
description: Put your stacking skills to work in a lightweight take on the timeless block puzzle. Keep your board tidy and chase your next line clear.
controls: Use arrow keys to move and rotate falling blocks. Check the game's control panel for additional shortcuts.
